about.description: MSFT is a single-stock perpetual on Paradex tracking Microsoft Corporation. Paradex is a permissionless perp and options DEX operating on its own Starknet-based appchain (Paradex Chain / DimeVM), with zero-fee trading, unified cross-margin in USDC, and ZK-encrypted account privacy. The market is cash-settled in USDC and does not confer any shareholder rights in the underlying.
